d:
Mokama vidhayak anant sinh ki beti shivangi ke tilak samaroh ko lekar taiyariyan jor-shor se chal rahi hain. danapur ke ek shandar risort men is khas samaroh ka aayojan kiya ja raha hai. mehmanon ke svagat se lekar sajavat aur any vyavasthaon tak har chhoti-bari taiyari par khas dhyan diya ja raha hai.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
